game.name: Breakout
dev.tip_multi: Multi ball: every ball splits into 3, moving independently and permanently until it leaves the field
dev.tip_pierce: Pierce ball: balls pass through bricks without bouncing, smashing along the way (lasts %d s)
dev.tip_fog: Fog: the central brick area is covered by a semi-transparent gray overlay (lasts %d s)
dev.tip_invert: Invert controls: mouse X/Y axes and paddle movement direction are reversed (lasts %d s)
dev.tip_clear_level: Clear level: instantly remove all bricks and trigger the clear bonus
dev.tip_ball_speed: Ball speed multiplier (applied on top of slow/fast ball effects)
dev.tip_paddle_length: Paddle length multiplier (applied on top of long/short paddle effects)
dev.tip_drop_rate: Power-up drop rate (chance a smashed brick drops a power-up)
